description: Unit tests for reading and writing reftable data structures, including buffer management, table creation, reference iteration, and error handling, for the reftable component in a version control system.

classes.name: reftable_buf
classes.description: Buffer structure for holding reftable data.

classes.name: reftable_block_source
classes.description: Abstracts a source for blocks of reftable data, such as buffers.

classes.name: reftable_block_data
classes.description: Holds a block of data read from a source.

classes.name: reftable_write_options
classes.description: Options controlling the behavior of reftable write operations.

classes.name: reftable_ref_record
classes.description: Represents a reference record in reftable.

classes.name: reftable_log_record
classes.description: Represents a log record in reftable.

classes.name: reftable_iterator
classes.description: Iterator for traversing references and logs in a reftable.

classes.name: reftable_table
classes.description: Represents a reftable, supporting queries like iteration and reference lookups.

classes.name: reftable_writer
classes.description: Handles writing data to a reftable buffer.

methods.name: void test_reftable_readwrite__buffer(void)
methods.description: Tests buffer addition and data reading from a reftable buffer.

methods.name: void write_table(char *** names,struct reftable_buf * buf,int N,int block_size,enum reftable_hash hash_id)
methods.description: Creates a reftable with a set of references and logs, writing them into a buffer.

methods.name: void test_reftable_readwrite__log_buffer_size(void)
methods.description: Tests the buffer extension during log compression in reftable writing.

methods.name: void test_reftable_readwrite__log_overflow(void)
methods.description: Tests handling of log record overflow conditions.

methods.name: void test_reftable_readwrite__log_write_limits(void)
methods.description: Ensures limit checks when writing logs with specific update indices.

methods.name: void test_reftable_readwrite__log_write_read(void)
methods.description: Performs full write/read cycle tests for reftable logs.

methods.name: void test_reftable_readwrite__log_zlib_corruption(void)
methods.description: Simulates and tests handling of corrupt zlib data in logs.

methods.name: void test_reftable_readwrite__table_read_write_sequential(void)
methods.description: Tests sequential reading from a table after bulk write.

methods.name: void test_reftable_readwrite__table_write_small_table(void)
methods.description: Verifies table writing with minimal data and size constraints.

methods.name: void test_reftable_readwrite__table_read_api(void)
methods.description: Tests the read API for reftable, including reference and log iteration.

methods.name: void t_table_read_write_seek(int index,enum reftable_hash hash_id)
methods.description: Generic test for seeking references within a table by index and hash type.

methods.name: void test_reftable_readwrite__table_read_write_seek_linear(void)
methods.description: Tests seek operations with linear index on a reftable.

methods.name: void test_reftable_readwrite__table_read_write_seek_linear_sha256(void)
methods.description: Seek test using SHA-256 hash type.

methods.name: void test_reftable_readwrite__table_read_write_seek_index(void)
methods.description: Seek test with index enabled on the table.

methods.name: void t_table_refs_for(int indexed)
methods.description: Generates a set of references with various hashes for testing references retrieval.

methods.name: void test_reftable_readwrite__table_refs_for_no_index(void)
methods.description: Tests reference iteration without index.

methods.name: void test_reftable_readwrite__table_refs_for_obj_index(void)
methods.description: Tests reference iteration with object index enabled.

methods.name: void test_reftable_readwrite__write_empty_table(void)
methods.description: Verifies behavior when writing an empty table.

methods.name: void test_reftable_readwrite__write_object_id_min_length(void)
methods.description: Checks the minimal length of object IDs in references.

methods.name: void test_reftable_readwrite__write_object_id_length(void)
methods.description: Checks the length of object IDs when varied.

methods.name: void test_reftable_readwrite__write_empty_key(void)
methods.description: Tests behavior with an empty reference key.

methods.name: void test_reftable_readwrite__write_key_order(void)
methods.description: Ensures reference keys are written in correct order.

methods.name: void test_reftable_readwrite__write_multiple_indices(void)
methods.description: Tests writing multiple references with different indices and subsequent reading.

methods.name: void test_reftable_readwrite__write_multi_level_index(void)
methods.description: Tests creation of multi-level index in reftable.

methods.name: void test_reftable_readwrite__corrupt_table_empty(void)
methods.description: Tests behavior when reftable data is empty or corrupted.

methods.name: void test_reftable_readwrite__corrupt_table(void)
methods.description: Tests reaction to corrupted reftable data.
